title: High Priest Nkosi Bakari
summary: Gather the five ritualist shades, then overcome their possession and healing link to the High Priest.
overview: Gather the five ritualist shades, then overcome their possession and healing link to the High Priest.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control the shades and plan around their charm rather than allowing repeated full boss heals.

phases.label: Ritual
phases.description: Release the shades and allow all five to reach the ritual.

phases.label: Priest and shades
phases.description: Control possession and remove the shades that can replenish the priest at half health.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Defeating the five invokers releases shades that travel to the central ritual.
The fifth arrival summons Nkosi Bakari and makes the shades attackable.
Engaged shades attempt Spiritual Possession after fifteen seconds; a shade returns when its possession ends.
At half health, the High Priest can absorb a surviving shade and return to full health, repeating while shades remain.
The priest and shades reset if pulled out of their permitted area.

notes: Approval E380. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
